title: 收购AI微SaaS，两年做到月入40万

author: 阿星
content:
**从SEO顾问到AI创业者，他的增长 playbook**

Ryan Darani过去6年在Internet上build各种business。Previous life，worked as SEO（in-house和agency）before launching SEO consultancy——first 'big' success。Peak时，consultancy reached $65K/MRR。

Then transitioned away from building solo businesses into SaaS和AI products。

现在做三个（jeesh）separate businesses in SaaS space。Main focus是**Cuppa**。

Cuppa是AI writing tool，designed create SEO-ready articles in minutes with no middleman costs。1000+ members，MRR fluctuates between $41K和$45K（depending on time of year）。

Spin-off from Cuppa，launched done-for-you service for agencies。Developed AI automation和'agent' replaces entire content operations of agency（writer、proofreader、editor）——all done through developed framework。

Launched service November 2024，signed first ten clients by end of December。Currently at $13.5K/MRR。

**Total：约$58K MRR（约40万人民币）。**

## 二、

Actually didn't come up with Cuppa idea。Someone much smarter——Chris Riley。Chris 2023年从indie developer手中purchased Cuppa，saw opportunity service SEO market find utility in AI content。

Then，Chris brought him in thanks to 10+ years experience in SEO space。Meant could put tool in hands of more people at much faster rate。Because done SEO so long，could put self in user's shoes think of new features、help with pricing、push on pain points know had with AI tools in past。

Opportunity worked brilliantly because just closed down consultancy。Had big enough safety net figure out what wanted do next，thankfully timing couldn't be better。

## 三、

**Phase 0**

Time、money、lot of brain power went into figuring out how run SaaS business on fly。Throw in some sweat和tears。

Thankfully，acquisition后first weekend，did lifetime deal、able pull in nearly entire amount spent acquiring free tool。Extremely helpful setting up success for two reasons：

1. Proved demand
2. Cash in door helpful begin put framework together scale product

Without initial success，doubt would be where today。Lot of credit due original builder of free tool——really able create strong following before acquired。

**Phase 1**

Initial phase after acquisition most hectic。Lasted approximately four to six months。Had put together team in real time make sure could handle all customer load和support ticket items coming through。Phase 1 of Cuppa.sh——entire process newly minted SaaS business（ops、development、sales、marketing）completely new to every single one。

From there，continued build和grow feature set directly from initial customers（life-time customers）feedback。Tapping into feedback critical for building initial foundation和future roadmap。

**Phase 2**

Most of 2024。Continue scale with customers，build new features、improve old ones，generally find "business stride"。

As with any newly-marketed SaaS product，ups和downs on daily basis。Learning和implementing in real time，but soon able handle和process learnings much more efficient manner。

**Phase 3**

Summer 2024，started plan next phase of Cuppa，transitioning from Cuppa.Sh to Cuppa.Ai。Time for complete product uplift，new brand、new website等——but all on same Cuppa.sh foundation。Pretty much everything needed level up move app from micro-SaaS to more professional、trustworthy SaaS brand。

Currently executing next level of growth for Cuppa.AI。

Funny，even during planned roadmap executions，so many things come along throw wrench into executing roadmap。Actually added new service-lite product into new Cuppa AI（not planned），saw pretty much immediate traction、enough demand had go back strategy drawing board make sure started executing vision和plan for that too。

Critical element to finding success building SaaS product：Moving quickly important，but also making sure pointed in right direction、executing with team as confident in direction as you are。

## 四、

Strong believer in **momentum** most important thing about business。Often fallen victim to，"Well，had good week，so can slow down next week"，dumbest thing can do in business。

Building business to six或seven figures isn't easy。Don't care how portrayed on X。Looking at 10-hour days doing repetitive、mundane tasks move needle bit-by-bit。Every so often do something hockey-stick growth but，in reality，small daily wins where growth happens。

Have to be self-motivator。Not like working 9-5。Have to wake up，commit to to-do list（non-negotiable IMO）、get things done without anybody telling what to do。

## 五、

**Influencer marketing**

Only few ways attract users into ecosystem。But best（by far）either building audience over time through personal brand或borrowing somebody else's audience（BOPA）。

Cuppa launched时，made initial investment back in single weekend。Purely because combined network of everybody involved。Since then，continued leverage networks of other people in return for either revenue splits或equity within business。

Pros：
- Quickly accelerate how many people pay for product
- Audience likely stick around longer if someone they trust recommends
- Accelerate word of mouth marketing（if product good enough）

Cons：
- Not every influencer/distributor right fit
- Losing percentage of every sale eats into margins
- Difficult source affiliates

Coupled with this，cross-promote services between businesses。Email lists thousands subscribers accumulated over last 18 months。Easy way increase revenue offer deals within ecosystem。Cuppa customers may also be DFY customers。

Thinking ahead，testing：
- Cold email outreach
- Inbound-led outbound
- Paid acquisition（very small budget allocation）

Always looking ways develop 'playbook'。Test channel，see if returns anything，if not，move on或develop new offers/strategies based on data。

## 六、

**Fighting churn**

Mix of businesses revenue models crazy。But good way，of course。

Cuppa subscription-based offering starts from $20/mo。Entry point great for all customers reduces friction during signup。

Issue presents is churn。Why？Because value proposition becomes price，rather than features或value of product itself。When customers go to market for alternative，looking for something cheaper——even if means reduction in features。

SaaS products take time develop、iterate、refine、improve。During which time churn biggest obstacle contend with。

At $460K/ARR with Cuppa right now，love for closer to $1M/ARR by end of year。If had 0% churn，likely there by middle of year。Making offering as 'sticky' as possible goal。

## 七、

Hesitant say word "mistake"，because ultimately mistakes或failed experiments led to where currently are。But，throw out entrepreneurial mindset moment、just say constant 'mistakes'、bad decisions、missed opportunities along way。

Anything specifically would've done differently hindsight？Sure。Definitely。100%。Wouldn't have done lifetime deal，wouldn't have partnered和hired manner did，would've tried raise small funds from network beginning，would've likely changed pricing structure way、way earlier。

But ultimately，think all about learning process。

Biggest challenge getting right people和team in place——still work in progress。No easy task，especially fully remote、global team。Must have had 15-20 developers come through product in 2023和2024。For one reason或another，didn't work out。When happens，everything shifts——roadmaps、strategy、improvements、everything。Same ops side、marketing side。Many tests、many trials。

## 八、

Best advice：**Don't look at what anybody else doing、try copy it。Doesn't work。**

Lot of great、intelligent people can build products much better、faster than he can。Big advantage over them understands marketing和distribution，where 99% indie hackers fall short。

**Product only as good as marketing。** Spend time learning about different distribution channels、more importantly，whether customers in these channels。If not，don't waste time。

Here's what should do：
1. Build MVP（don't overengineer）
2. Manually reach out to 100 people want test product
3. Collect feedback
4. See if have product-market fit。If any of those 100 willingly pay，have validation solves problem
5. From there，iterate、launch to masses！

## 写在最后

Ryan的故事是关于pivot和growth——

从SEO顾问，到收购AI工具，到$58K MRR。

Key insights——

- Buy + Improve can work（if you have distribution skills）
- Phased approach to growth
- Influencer equity partnerships
- Churn is the enemy
- Marketing > Product quality（unfortunately）

最重要的是，**he knows his advantage is distribution**，not coding。

That's why he's winning。
